answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock: a new identity locks a bond of twice 30 days' earnings, released as its fingerprint matures over 20 epochs. A whisper of copied text or a ripple of identical timing across accounts flags the cluster, and a violet marker tags suspects. Forging 100 identities posts 100 bonds worth 6,000 days of earnings, and each fake must do 20 epochs of real work to unlock. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps full rewards.
